products.title: Ejaazi
products.body_html:
Ejaazi by Lattafa Perfumes is a Amber fragrance for women and men. Ejaazi was launched in 2018. Top notes are Citruses, Cardamom, Orange, Lavender and Myrtle; middle notes are Pepper, Patchouli, Lily-of-the-Valley and Cinnamon Leaf; base notes are Ambroxan, Woodsy Notes, Amber, Cedar, Oakmoss and Vetiver.

Top Notes
Citruses, Lavender, Orange, Cardamom, Myrtle

Middle Notes
Pepper, Patchouli, Lily-of-the-Valley, Cinnamon Leaf

Base Notes
Ambroxan, Woodsy Notes, Amber, Cedar, Oakmoss, Vetiver

products.title: Eclaire
products.body_html:
The fragrance opens with the top notes of caramel, milk, and sugar captivate the senses with their rich and creamy sweetness, reminiscent of a decadent confection. In the heart, delicate white flowers intertwine with golden honey, creating a floral and honeyed bouquet. As the fragrance settles, the base notes of vanilla, praline, and musk emerge, wrapping you in a comforting embrace of creamy vanilla, nutty praline, and velvety musk.

Top Notes
Caramel, Milk, Sugar

Middle Notes
Honey, White Flowers

Base Notes
Vanilla, Praline, Musk

products.title: Blue Oud
products.body_html:

Agarwood (Oud), Black Pepper, Apple, Bergamot

Middle Notes
Fruits, Musk, Saffron, Sage, Jasmine

Base Notes
Ambergris, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood

products.body_html:

Base Notes

products.body_html:

products.title: Badee Al Oud Sublime Set
products.body_html:
Indulge in the luxurious allure of Badee Al Oud Sublime, a captivating fragrance that celebrates elegance and opulence. This premium gift set features a 100ml Eau De Parfum, a 200ml Deodorant, and a 300ml Air Freshener, offering a complete olfactory experience for both personal wear and enhancing your surroundings.

Middle Notes

products.title: Badee Al Oud Noble Blush
products.body_html:
Discover the enchanting allure of Badee Al Oud Noble Blush, a fragrance that captures the essence of a sweet, dreamy fantasy. With a top note of delicate Rose Milk, this scent opens with a gentle, romantic touch. The heart notes of Almond and Meringue bring a deliciously soft and creamy richness, while the base notes of Sandalwood, Vanilla, and Musk add warmth and depth, creating an irresistible, velvety finish. Perfectly crafted to evoke a sense of wonder, Noble Blush is a true delight from the Badee Al Oud collection, turning every moment into a whiff of pure enchantment.

Top Notes
Rose Milk

Middle Notes
Meringue, Almond

Base Notes
Vanilla, Musk, Sandalwood

products.title: Badee Al Oud Honor And Glory Set
products.body_html:

Launched in 2023, this perfume opens with notes from crème brulee and pineapple, followed by notes from turmeric, black pepper, benzoin and cinnamon. The base is filled with notes from cashmeran, moss, sandalwood and vanilla.

Top Notes

Middle Notes
Cinnamon, Turmeric, Black Pepper, Benzoin

Base Notes

products.title: Badee Al Oud Amethyst
products.body_html:
Perfume Oud For Glory Amethyst - Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum by Lattafa Perfumes is a warm fragrance with vanilla, amber and roses. The top note starts with spicy pink pepper and fresh bergamot. The heart note is floral with Turkish roses, Bulgarian roses and jasmine. Oudh, vanilla and amber perfectly round off the perfume in the base. Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst is an exceptionally successful blend of roses, Oudh and warm notes that is very suitable for any occasion.

Top Notes
Pink Pepper, Bergamot

Middle Notes
Turkish Rose, Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine

Base Notes
Agarwood (Oud), Amber, Vanilla

products.title: Atheeri
products.body_html:
Atheeri is a soft and ethereal floral gourmand fragrance for everyone from the house of Lattafa. It captures the essence of golden sunlight filtering through a serene garden, where the freshness of morning dew mingles with the intoxicating sweetness of passionflower. At its heart, a delicate bouquet of orchid and jasmine evokes a sense of timeless elegance. The fragrance settles into a sensual embrace of creamy vanilla and rich Amberwood, leaving behind a soft yet captivating trail of warmth and allure.

Top Notes
Passion Flower, Dew Drop

Middle Notes
Orchid, Jasmine

Base Notes
Vanilla, Amberwood

products.title: Asad Zanzibar
products.body_html:
Embrace the essence of adventure with Lattafa Asad Zanzibar, a fragrance that evokes the spirit of discovery and the allure of exotic destinations. Named after the mesmerizing island of Zanzibar, known for its pristine beaches, vibrant culture, and rich history, this fragrance captures the essence of this tropical paradise in a bottle.

Top Notes
Lavender, Black Pepper

Middle Notes
Coconut Water, Iris, Salt

Base Notes
Vanilla, Incense

Middle Notes

products.title: Asad & Zanzibar Set
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad 5th Anniversary Gift Set For Men with Asad EDP 3.4 Fl Oz + Asad Zanzibar EDP 3.4 Fl Oz. Asad by Lattafa Perfumes is a Vanilla fragrance for men. Top notes are Black Pepper, Tobacco and Pineapple; middle notes are Patchouli, Coffee and Iris; base notes are Vanilla, Amber, Dry Wood, Benzoin and Labdanum. Asad Zanzibar By Lattafa Perfumes is an Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. Asad Zanzibar was launched in 2024. The nose behind this fragrance is Fanny Bal. Top notes are Lavender and Black Pepper; middle notes are Coconut Water, Iris and Salt; base notes are Vanilla and Incense.

products.title: Asad Set
products.body_html:
This fragrance opens with a bold and intriguing blend of spicy black pepper, juicy pineapple, and rich tobaco, creating a striking and unique introduction. The heart reveals a warm fusion of dark coffee, patchouli, and the powdery elegance of iris, adding depth and sophistication. As it dries down, the base of smooth amber, sweet vanilla, dry woods, benzoin, and labdanum leaves a warm, resinous, and smoky finish. Perfect for those who appreciate a daring, bold scent with a blend of spicy, sweet, and woody undertones. Asad Eau De Parfum Spray 100MLAsad Perfumed Spray 200MLAsad Hair Mist 50ML

Top Notes
Black Pepper, Tobacco, Pineapple

Middle Notes
Patchouli, Coffee, Iris

Base Notes
Vanilla, Amber, Dry Wood, Benzoin, Labdanum

products.title: Angham
products.body_html:
Introducing Angham, our latest fragrance, inspired by the enchanting rhythm of music. This olfactory symphony blends the vibrant notes of Pink Pepper, the elegance of Jasmine, the zest of Ginger, and the warmth of Vanilla. Let each note come together in a harmonious dance, captivating your senses and evoking the magic of a beautifully composed melody. With Angham, experience the perfect harmony of scent and sound, and let the music of fragrance enchant you.

Top Notes
Ginger, Mandarin, Pink Pepper

Middle Notes
Lavender, Praline, Cacao, Jasmine

Base Notes
Vanilla, Amber, Musk

products.title: Ana Abiyedh Coral
products.body_html:
Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Coral is a captivating unisex fragrance that exudes warmth and elegance. It opens with a luscious blend of peach, watermelon, and orange, creating a juicy and refreshing introduction. The heart reveals a delicate fusion of coconut and white florals, adding a creamy, tropical touch. As the scent settles, a rich base of vanilla, amber, and musk envelops the skin, leaving a soft, sensual trail. Perfect for any occasion, Ana Abiyedh Coral is a radiant and inviting fragrance that embodies sophistication and charm.

Top Notes
Watermelon, Peach, Orange

Middle Notes
Coconut, White Flowers

Base Notes
Vanilla, Amber, Musk

products.title: Ajwad Pink To Pink
products.body_html:
Ajwad Pink to Pink by Lattafa Perfumes is a captivating new fragrance for both women and men, launched in 2024. This enchanting scent opens with a lively and refreshing blend of guava, pink grapefruit, lychee, and pink pepper, creating a vibrant and succulent introduction. As the fragrance develops, the heart notes unveil a beautiful floral bouquet, featuring the timeless elegance of rose, the delicate charm of peony, and the graceful allure of magnolia. In the base, rich and warm notes of leather, musk, ambergris, vanilla, and moss come together, providing a sensual and enduring finish. Ajwad Pink to Pink is a harmonious composition that leaves a lasting impression of sophistication and allure.

Top Notes
Guava, Pink Grapefruit, Litchi, Pink Pepper

Middle Notes
Rose, Peony, Magnolia

Base Notes
Leather, Musk, Ambergris, Vanilla, Moss

products.title: Ajayab Dubai Portrait
products.body_html: Ajayeb Dubai Portrait by Lattafa Perfumes is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Ajayeb Dubai Portrait was launched in 2023. Top notes are Orange and Lemon; middle notes are Mango, Osmanthus and Jasmine; base notes are Sandalwood, Amber, Musk and Oud.

products.title: Afeef
products.body_html:
Lattafa Afeef Eau de Parfum is a versatile fragrance crafted for everyone, delivering a harmonious blend of fresh, floral, and warm notes in a 3.4 oz / 100 ml spray. It opens with an invigorating burst of bergamot, accented by the subtle spice of pink pepper and a touch of juicy peach. At its heart, an enchanting bouquet of jasmine, orange flower, and tuberose adds depth and floral elegance. The fragrance settles into a warm, inviting base of sandalwood, amber, praline, and patchouli, leaving a memorable, sophisticated trail suitable for any occasion.

Top Notes
Peach, Pink Pepper, Bergamot

Middle Notes
Tuberose, Jasmine, Orange Blossom

Base Notes
Sandalwood, Amber, Praline, Patchouli
